xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
Legend
draw.io C4 palette: dark blue = Person, blue = Software System, cyan = Container, light cyan = Component,
muted violet = external system. General applications/components are rounded blocks; data, object, and
file stores share the data-container cylinder; message buses use a horizontal cylinder; browser uses the
C4 window. Solid blue/neutral frames = logical/placement scope; dotted frames = organization. Arrows
show named directed interactions. Font contrast is adapted; sizes fit text, not quantity.
